audit: erun unexpose --dry-run --platform-namespace frs-prod --services-zone services.erunpaas.com team dev
unexpose: per-env wildcard *.team-dev.services.erunpaas.com (zone services.erunpaas.com)
unexpose: platform powerdns namespace frs-prod
kubectl -n frs-prod exec deploy/frs-powerdns -- pdnsutil --config-dir=/etc/pdns-shared delete-rrset services.erunpaas.com '*.team-dev' A
